outputs.explanation: Panel A is a spatial transcriptomics cluster map overlaid on a tissue image (micrograph-type), not a plot of averaged data; individual data points are not applicable.
Panel B shows H&E tissue images with manual region annotations (micrograph/photograph), not a summary plot; individual data points are not applicable.
Panel C shows tissue images with spatial gene-expression heatmap overlays; heatmaps are exempt from needing individual data points.
Panel D consists of GSEA enrichment plots (line plots), which are exempt from requiring overlaid individual data points.

Panel E is a bar chart of log2 fold-change values per gene derived from a single Seurat differential expression comparison (Tmprss11b-high vs low), not a mean/average of multiple replicate measurements, so there are no underlying individual data points to overlay.
